title: MW6 Aether Reliquary content tools
purpose: Keep full-game content additions registry-first, locally validated, and safe for versioned saves before runtime expansion.

registries.label: Major cities
registries.coverage: 12 major city hubs, culture, factions, level ranges, routes, campaign role
registries.addWorkflow: Add the city canon first, then connect routes, quests, vendors, enemies, and playtest coverage.

registries.label: Sub-cities and districts
registries.coverage: 48 sub-cities, local conflicts, champions, shops, secrets, codex hooks
registries.addWorkflow: Attach every sub-city to one major city and define at least one local conflict plus unlock posture.

registries.label: Quest and campaign arcs
registries.coverage: main phases, city questlines, side arcs, route choices, quest flags
registries.addWorkflow: Create stable quest IDs, dependency flags, reward references, and journal summary text before UI wiring.

registries.label: Enemy families and archetypes
registries.coverage: families, traits, statuses, regional archetypes, tactics, drops, codex entries
registries.addWorkflow: Define family and trait data first, then attach regional enemy profiles and loot/codex references.

registries.label: Bosses and unique monsters
registries.coverage: sub-city champions, city bosses, act bosses, Hollow Regent forms, world bosses
registries.addWorkflow: Attach every unique enemy to a lair, phase rule, weakness hint, codex entry, and unique drop.

registries.label: Items, gear, and rewards
registries.coverage: weapon families, gear slots, qualities, affixes, sockets, set bonuses, unique relics
registries.addWorkflow: Add item bases and reward sources together so drops, vendors, quests, and crafting stay deterministic.

registries.label: Vendors and city economies
registries.coverage: vendor archetypes, city currencies, price rules, reputation discounts, refresh posture
registries.addWorkflow: Pair vendor inventory with city currency, reputation gate, deterministic stock, and anti-grind pricing.

registries.label: Crafting and salvage recipes
registries.coverage: forge recipes, salvage outputs, upgrade costs, rune/socket economy
registries.addWorkflow: Add input and output materials with upgrade caps, class synergy, and salvage fallback before runtime use.

registries.label: Companions and NPC rosters
registries.coverage: eight recruitable companions, perks, loyalty quests, NPC roles, city reactions
registries.addWorkflow: Define companion perk and loyalty quest before adding recruitment actions or travel banter.

registries.label: Dialogue flags and story memory
registries.coverage: dialogue flags, moral choices, recurring rivals, companion reactions, city outcomes
registries.addWorkflow: Use durable save flags and compact journal summaries before adding new branches.

registries.label: Maps, routes, and coordinates
registries.coverage: city map cards, world routes, district coordinates, locked doors, fast-travel gates
registries.addWorkflow: Register route endpoints, level range, biome, unlock flag, and map coordinate notes together.

registries.label: Save flags and progression dependencies
registries.coverage: quest, codex, map, enemy, companion, crafting, reputation, endgame, and recovery flags
registries.addWorkflow: Normalize additive flags through save migration before any Phaser or drawer reads them.

helpers.label: Zone scaffold checklist
helpers.safeUse: Use before adding a city or dungeon to verify canon, route, enemy, quest, vendor, and reward references.
helpers.output: A registry-backed checklist for zone additions without touching renderer state.

helpers.label: Quest dependency checker
helpers.safeUse: Use when adding campaign, city, sub-city, loyalty, or bounty quests.
helpers.output: Missing dependency, reward, flag, and journal references fail before runtime.

helpers.label: Map coordinate helper
helpers.safeUse: Use to keep district card coordinates, route endpoints, and Phaser test positions documented outside renderer callbacks.
helpers.output: Coordinate notes and route anchors stay registry-owned and save-safe.

helpers.label: Dialogue flag audit
helpers.safeUse: Use before adding dialogue branches, companion reactions, city outcomes, or moral choice flags.
helpers.output: Dialogue memory flags stay durable, local-first, and journal-readable.

helpers.label: Fixture save writer
helpers.safeUse: Use after adding save fields so old and new fixtures prove migration and recovery behavior.
helpers.output: MW5 v2, raw v3, envelope v1, corrupted, world-loop, and endgame fixtures remain documented.

helpers.label: Development debug overlay contract
helpers.safeUse: Only expose spawn, teleport, quest, and state debug helpers behind development posture; never ship as player controls.
helpers.output: Debug affordances remain documented, non-public, and excluded from production gameplay promises.

helpers.label: Spawn and encounter test command
helpers.safeUse: Use fixture saves and E2E seeds to test enemies, bosses, loot, and route events without hand-editing local storage.
helpers.output: Repeatable encounter coverage for combat, loot, codex, and progression checks.

helpers.label: Balance snapshot helper
helpers.safeUse: Use after changing XP, loot, crafting, boss timing, potion pressure, or class viability targets.
helpers.output: Balance fixtures stay deterministic before release E2E widens.

fixtureSaves.label: Legacy MW5 v2 save
fixtureSaves.coverage: Old vertical-slice save migration into v3 identity and slots.

fixtureSaves.label: Raw MW6 v3 save
fixtureSaves.coverage: Current save payload import without envelope metadata.

fixtureSaves.label: Envelope v1 save
fixtureSaves.coverage: Autosave, manual, and checkpoint slot restoration.

fixtureSaves.label: Corrupted import fixture
fixtureSaves.coverage: Import failure state that must never wipe local progress.

fixtureSaves.label: World-loop unlocked fixture
fixtureSaves.coverage: City discovery, selected sub-city, quest acceptance, faction reputation, and companion travel state.

fixtureSaves.label: Endgame-ready fixture
fixtureSaves.coverage: Dungeon, relic trial, boss rematch, treasure map, arena, cosmetic, and collection test posture.

progressionChecks.label: Route endpoints resolve
progressionChecks.guards: Every route connects valid city, sub-city, or reliquary nodes.
progressionChecks.failureMode: Travel UI can show a destination the save cannot unlock.

progressionChecks.label: Quest dependencies resolve
progressionChecks.guards: Every quest flag, prerequisite, reward, and journal reference is stable.
progressionChecks.failureMode: Journal or city progression can strand the player.

progressionChecks.label: Enemy drops resolve
progressionChecks.guards: Enemy, boss, champion, and world-boss drops reference valid items and codex IDs.
progressionChecks.failureMode: Combat can reward missing gear or undiscoverable codex entries.

progressionChecks.label: Vendor economy resolves
progressionChecks.guards: Vendor inventories reference valid currency, price, reputation, and item rules.
progressionChecks.failureMode: Shop UI can sell impossible or unpriced items.

progressionChecks.label: Crafting and salvage resolve
progressionChecks.guards: Recipes and salvage outputs have valid materials, caps, and item outputs.
progressionChecks.failureMode: Forge actions can consume or create invalid inventory state.

progressionChecks.label: Companion state resolves
progressionChecks.guards: Recruitment, loyalty, perk, banter, and city reaction flags are additive and save-safe.
progressionChecks.failureMode: People drawer can show companions without valid progression state.

progressionChecks.label: Map coordinate notes resolve
progressionChecks.guards: City and district map notes remain registry-owned and renderer-independent.
progressionChecks.failureMode: Phaser map work can drift from canonical city/sub-city content.

progressionChecks.label: Save migration covers new fields
progressionChecks.guards: Every additive progression field normalizes from older saves.
progressionChecks.failureMode: Existing players can lose progress or crash on reload.

authoringRules: Add canon data before runtime UI.
Keep simulation and save state in lib modules, not Phaser callbacks.
Use stable IDs that never depend on display labels.
Every city has exactly four sub-cities before the registry can pass.
Every new progression flag must normalize from older saves.
Every asset reference must pass the asset manifest and visible-credit rules.
Every quest branch needs a compact journal summary.
Every boss or champion needs a codex hint and deterministic reward source.
Every vendor, recipe, and loot source needs anti-grind balance intent.
Development debug helpers are documentation and test contracts only, not public player controls.
